## Summary

I implemented **F007 — the pre-dispatch sizing gate** for plan `2026-06-01-001-feat-plan-review-scope-validation`. I added a new pure module `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/plan_review/sizing_gate.py` that runs the existing F001 scope lint over a single target feature, selects only the block-severity **size** flags (`over_surface`/`over_ac`/`likely_timeout` — deliberately ignoring precision/coupling signals so the gate adds *only* the size check per acceptance #4), surfaces the F002 split proposal as remediation, and records an override rationale to an evidence sidecar (mirroring the codebase's `override.json` convention). I then wired it into `_dispatch_from_plan_main` in `cli.py`: the F001 sizing lint now runs in the pre-flight in both dry-run and confirm modes, and on `--confirm` an over-budget feature is refused (new exit code 5, before any paid `dispatch_volley` call, after the existing quota-readiness check stays intact) with the split proposal printed — unless `--allow-oversize <reason>` (≥8 chars, reusing the existing validator) is supplied, which records the rationale and proceeds.
